# China EV Mart

> An independent information platform for discovering Chinese new-energy vehicles, comparing vehicle specifications, researching automotive technology, and evaluating export-market requirements. Published by Chengguang Energy (Jinzhou Chengguang Power Source Co., Ltd.).

## What is China EV Mart

China EV Mart is a structured product database of Chinese new-energy vehicles — deep specifications, trim/version variants, powertrain and technology details, and export-market context. We cover 517 vehicle models across 72 Chinese EV brands.

## Key documents

- [Vehicle Database](https://chinaevmart.com/vehicles/): 517 Chinese EV models with specs, trims, and export-market reference data.
- [Home](https://chinaevmart.com/): platform overview.
- [Evidence & Data Methodology](https://chinaevmart.com/methodology/): how sources are selected, verified and dated.
- [Editorial Independence Policy](https://chinaevmart.com/editorial-independence/): ownership vs editorial control, review process, corrections, advertising and affiliate disclosure.

## Policies and compliance

- [Evidence & Data Methodology](https://chinaevmart.com/methodology/): how sources are selected, verified and dated.
- [Editorial Independence Policy](https://chinaevmart.com/editorial-independence/): ownership vs editorial control, review process, corrections, advertising and affiliate disclosure.
- [Image Credits and Copyright](https://chinaevmart.com/image-credits/): full attribution and licence for every freely licensed photograph used on the site.
- [Copyright, Trademarks and Takedown Policy](https://chinaevmart.com/copyright/): permitted reuse of our content and figures, trademark usage, and the notice-and-takedown procedure.

## Machine-readable markdown

Every vehicle and blog page has a clean Markdown variant at the same path with a `.md` suffix — generated at build time from the same data layer as the HTML page, with no navigation, footer, or JavaScript.

- Vehicle pages: `/vehicles/{slug}.md`
- Blog posts: `/blog/{slug}.md`

Examples:

- https://chinaevmart.com/vehicles/byd-seal.md
- https://chinaevmart.com/vehicles/xiaomi-su7.md
- https://chinaevmart.com/vehicles/zeekr-001.md
- https://chinaevmart.com/blog/byd-seal-deep-review.md
- https://chinaevmart.com/blog/chinese-ev-export-landscape-2026.md
